description:
Typed payload for MissionCreated catalog events.

``actor`` (8.0.0) carries the opaque identifier of whoever created the
mission so the broadcast moment can say WHO (E2E-MVP §1.1 renders
"<actor> created mission <slug>"). Optional — not required — because the
live producer built these payloads without it before 8.0.0; requiring it
would fail every in-flight emission at upgrade instead of enriching the
moment once producers catch up.

actor.description: Opaque actor identifier of who created the mission (broadcast under the moment's ``actor`` key)
actor.title: Actor

mission_id.description: Canonical machine-facing mission identity (ULID); optional, rides alongside mission_slug so a consumer can join this moment against PhaseEntered (whose frame ref is mission_id) for the same mission aggregate (spec-kitty-events#69)
mission_id.title: Mission Id

target_branch.description: Target branch for the mission planning artifacts
target_branch.title: Target Branch

wp_count.description: Work-package count at mission creation time
wp_count.title: Wp Count

title: MissionCreatedPayload
